stem:
Give IUPAC names of the following compounds:
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{Cl})-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\)
(ii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{O}-\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3\)
(iii) a benzene ring carrying \(-\text{OH}\) at position 1 and \(-\text{CH}_3\) groups at both positions 2 and 6
(iv) a cyclohexane ring carrying \(-\text{NO}_2\) at one carbon and \(-\text{OC}_2\text{H}_5\) at the adjacent carbon

Give the structures and IUPAC names of the products expected from the following reactions:
(a) Catalytic reduction of butanal.
(b) Hydration of propene in the presence of dilute sulphuric acid.
(c) Reaction of propanone with methylmagnesium bromide followed by hydrolysis.

Arrange the following sets of compounds in order of their increasing boiling points:
(a) Pentan-1-ol, butan-1-ol, butan-2-ol, ethanol, propan-1-ol, methanol.
(b) Pentan-1-ol, n-butane, pentanal, ethoxyethane.
solution:
(a) Methanol, ethanol, propan-1-ol, butan-2-ol, butan-1-ol, pentan-1-ol.
(b) n-Butane, ethoxyethane, pentanal and pentan-1-ol.

Classify the following as primary, secondary and tertiary alcohols:
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)_2-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\)
(ii) \(\text{H}_2\text{C}=\text{CH}-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\)
(iii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{OH}\)
(iv) \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5-\text{CH}(\text{OH})-\text{CH}_3\)
(v) \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{OH})-\text{CH}_3\)
(vi) \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5-\text{CH}=\text{CH}-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)_2-\text{OH}\)
Identify allylic alcohols in the above examples.

Show how are the following alcohols prepared by the reaction of a suitable Grignard reagent on methanal?
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\)
(ii) cyclohexyl\(-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\) (a cyclohexane ring bearing a \(-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\) group)

Write structures of the products of the following reactions:
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}=\text{CH}_2 \xrightarrow{\text{H}_2\text{O}/\text{H}^+}\)
(ii) methyl 2-(2-oxocyclohexyl)acetate, i.e. a cyclohexanone ring bearing a \(-\text{CH}_2-\text{C}(=\text{O})-\text{OCH}_3\) group on the carbon adjacent to the ring carbonyl, treated with \(\text{NaBH}_4\)
(iii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CHO} \xrightarrow{\text{NaBH}_4}\)
